गिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Who or what swallows.
 m. (-लः)
 1. The citron.
2. Swallowing.
 E. गॄ to swallow, affix क, and र changed to ल.

गिलग्राह m. (-हः) A shark.
 E. गिल, and ग्राह who seizes, who swallows.

गिलत् mfn. (-लन्-लन्ती-लत्) Swallowing, eating, devouring.
 E. गै to swal-
low, शतृ aff.
गिलन n. (-नं) Swallowing; also गिरण. E. As before; र changed to ल.

. Eating. E. See गिरि, र being changed
to ल.

. Swallowed. गॄ to swallow, affix क्त,
गिरित, and र changed to ल.
